Xendit is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.

About the Job

We are seeking a highly motivated and strategically-minded Account Manager to own and grow our regional/global enterprise portfolio, based in our Jakarta office, working in a hybrid model. This position is dedicated to our most complex and high-value enterprise clients — primarily cross-border e-commerce leaders, global SaaS platforms, and large-scale financial institutions across Indonesia and the wider APAC region. You’ll join Xendit’s Enterprise Account Management team, working closely with Go-to-Market, Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Operations and Risk leadership. You will not just manage accounts — you will architect growth.

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of B2B account management or strategic sales experience in financial services, fintech, or payments.
• Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets, ideally in a role with direct P&L, book-of-business, or portfolio revenue ownership.
• Experience managing and growing revenue within large and complex enterprise accounts.
• You understand the needs of international cross-border merchants and the cultural nuances of doing business across APAC markets. Familiarity with the APAC region is essential.
• Professional proficiency in both English and Bahasa Indonesia.
• Core Competencies:
• Builder & Founder-Like Mentality: You thrive in “zero-to-one” environments. You are hands-on, take full ownership, and are relentless in removing blockers for your clients and your team.
• Exceptional Communicator: You can present persuasively in the boardroom, and translate complex payment concepts for executive audiences.
• Data-Led & Analytical: You make decisions based on data, not gut feel. You can analyze transaction patterns to identify risk and untapped potential.

Attributes We Value:

• Hustle with Integrity: You move fast, but you build trust through transparency and reliability.
• Curiosity: You constantly ask “why” and dig deep to understand the root problem, not just the surface request.
• Resilience: You are undeterred by long sales cycles and complex procurement processes.

Responsibilities

1.⁠ ⁠Strategic Portfolio Growth & Revenue Ownership

• Own the full P&L for a portfolio of key enterprise accounts. Drive revenue and transaction volume through upselling, cross-selling (payment acceptance, payouts, platform business) and use case expansion.
• Develop and execute comprehensive 12-18 month account plans for each major client, articulating clear growth strategies and proactively managing churn risk.
• Consistently exceed revenue targets by focusing on high-impact input metrics and maintaining a clean, accurate pipeline.

2.⁠ ⁠Executive & Multi-Stakeholder Relationship Building

• Build and nurture C-level relationships (CEO, CFO, CPO, CTO) within your accounts. Understand their strategic objectives and align Xendit’s roadmap to solve their core business challenges.
• Lead client business reviews, providing data-driven insights and demonstrating clear ROI.
• Serve as the trusted advisor and single point of contact, navigating complex organizational structures to secure client buy-in and consensus.

3.⁠ ⁠Cross-Functional Influence

• Bring your clients’ needs back to Xendit, informing and influencing our product roadmap and strategy.
• Partner with cross-functional teams (Product, Solution Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Risk) to identify and scope net-new opportunities, bridging the gap between commercial terms and technical feasibility.

4.⁠ ⁠Market Intelligence & Local Expertise

• Stay ahead of regulatory shifts and payment trends. Act as a subject matter expert on cross-border flows between Xendit markets in APAC.
• Identify synergies between Xendit’s licensed infrastructure and the specific needs of enterprises expanding into the region.

Why Join Xendit?

• Impact at Scale: You won’t be a small cog in a giant machine. You will own a significant book of business that directly impacts Xendit’s regional growth.
• Licensed Infrastructure: Sell more than just a gateway. You have acquiring, remittance , banking, VASP, and lending licenses as your arsenal.
• Culture of Builders: We are a team of doers. We hire people who want to build, not just maintain.
• Accelerated Career Growth: We promote from within and offer high-visibility projects with direct exposure to global leadership.

Xendit is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

About the Role

As Central Planning & Process Control Manager at RAB, you’ll own two connected parts of our driver rental operation. The first is how we plan it: the right vehicles, drivers and people in the right place at the right time. The second is how we control it: clear processes, reliable data, and deviations caught before they turn into losses. You’ll turn demand signals, fleet data and team capacity into one operating plan. You’ll also build the process and control framework that makes sure the plan is carried out correctly, from driver onboarding and vehicle deployment to payments, support and collection. You’ll lead a small team of planners and Process Controllers, and your work directly drives fleet utilization, activation targets and leakage reduction across thousands of drivers in Jabodetabek. You’ll work closely with Business Operations leadership, Acquisition/Onboarding, Driver Support, Vehicle Ops, Fleet Partners, Finance/Collection, and the internal tools (RABOS) team.

What you will do

Central Planning

• Build and own the weekly and monthly operating plan: driver activation targets, vehicle allocation across pools and partners, and frontline team capacity.
• Forecast vehicle supply (incoming units, migrations, returns, units in service or repair) against driver demand, and flag gaps early.
• Plan vehicle deployment and redeployment to maximize utilization and minimize idle days, including handover, service and return schedules.
• Run the planning cadence (weekly planning meetings, plan vs. actual tracking) and run scenario analyses to support management decisions.

Process & Control

• Own RAB’s process and control framework: the end-to-end process map, a clear owner and source of truth for each step, and SOPs built into RABOS and FMS rather than left as static documents.
• Design control points and KPIs (utilization, idle vehicle days, activation vs. target, SLA, ticket aging, reconciliation gaps, no-show rates) and report on them through dashboards.
• Lead investigations of process deviations and losses (e.g. unreconciled payments, mis-routed tickets, idle or mis-allocated vehicles) and drive corrective actions to closure.
• Run periodic process audits and data reconciliations between operational systems and finance records.

Leadership & Change

• Lead, coach and develop a team of planners and Process Controllers.
• Work with product/tech to automate planning inputs, allocation rules, controls and access rights inside our tools.
• Govern process and plan changes: lead rollouts (training, communication to teams and drivers) and run post-launch reviews.

What you will need

• 5+ years of experience in operations planning, supply/demand or fleet planning, business process improvement, operations excellence, or audit, with at least 2 years leading a team.
• Hands-on experience in both planning (forecasting, capacity and allocation) and process control (SOPs, process mapping, audits and reconciliation).
• Strong data skills: advanced spreadsheets (pivot, lookup, forecasting models, reconciliation); SQL or BI tools are a strong plus.
• Structured problem-solving: able to turn messy, multi-source data into a simple plan, find the root causes of deviations, and push practical, tool-based fixes.
• Strong stakeholder management: able to influence leadership, partners and frontline teams, and to make trade-off calls with incomplete data.
• Experience in rental, fleet, mobility, logistics or high-volume operations is a plus.
• Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia and good working English; based in or able to work in Tangerang - Ciater.

About the Team

GoCar Fleet provides economic opportunity for Indonesians without their own vehicles to earn a good living as GoCar driver-partners. We offer affordable rental and massive selection of electric vehicles. GoCar Fleet is at a rapid growth pace, acquiring a significant number of revenue-generating vehicle assets every quarter.

You’ll be part of the Business Operations team at RAB, a car rental serving GoCar drivers across Jabodetabek. We sit at the center of the business. We turn targets and fleet data into plans that driver support, vehicle ops, onboarding and collection can execute, and we make sure that work connects through clear ownership, reliable data, and processes built into our own tools. We like to work from real data and frontline input, test changes quickly, and treat plans and SOPs as living tools rather than paperwork. Our mission is to build an operation that scales without losing control, and we’d love for you to help shape it.

About GoTo Group
GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.
The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
